name: gaussianedit-orchestration
description: Dispatches one immutable GaussianEdit handoff through its authenticated board and the documented GitHub Codex trigger.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch one immutable GaussianEdit handoff safely.
interface.longDescription: Reads the authenticated GaussianEdit board, claims one authorized handoff, and uses a draft GitHub pull request plus one idempotent @codex comment to start cloud work.
defaultPrompt: Use $dispatch-cloud-work to dispatch at most one eligible GaussianEdit handoff.
Check the private board and return NOOP when no immutable handoff is eligible.
